tools.name: calc_concrete_slab
tools.description: Cubic yards, bags, truck loads and weight for a slab, with multiple sections and an optional thickened edge. Estimate only; confirm with your plans, supplier and local code.

system.description: Unit system the inputs are typed in and the defaults are taken from.

length.description: Length. Unit: ft (imperial) or m (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 6. Type 20, 20 ft 6 in or 20' 6″.

width.description: Width. Unit: ft (imperial) or m (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 3.6.

thickness.description: Thickness. Unit: in (imperial) or cm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 10cm. Common practice: 4″ for patios and walks, 5″–6″ under vehicles. Confirm with your plans and local code.

waste.description: Waste allowance. Unit: %. Covers subgrade dips, spillage and the last wheelbarrow.

bagSize.description: Bag size. Options: 90 = 90 lb bag (regional availability); 80 = 80 lb bag; 60 = 60 lb bag; 50 = 50 lb bag; 40 = 40 lb bag.

price.description: Ready-mix price. Unit: $ / cu yd (imperial) or $ / m³ (metric). Optional. Your delivered price, per the unit shown on the field. Leave blank to skip cost.

length2.description: Section 2 length. Unit: ft (imperial) or m (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in".

width2.description: Section 2 width. Unit: ft (imperial) or m (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in".

length3.description: Section 3 length. Unit: ft (imperial) or m (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in".

width3.description: Section 3 width. Unit: ft (imperial) or m (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in".

edge.description: Thickened edge (turndown). A deeper perimeter strip poured monolithically with the slab.

edgeDepth.description: Edge depth. Unit: in (imperial) or cm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 30cm. Shown on the site only when "edge" is set.

edgeWidth.description: Edge width. Unit: in (imperial) or cm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 30cm. Shown on the site only when "edge" is set.

gravel.description: Gravel base depth. Unit: in (imperial) or cm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 10cm. Set to 0 to leave the base off the takeoff.

unitWeight.description: Unit weight. Unit: lb / cu ft. Assumption, lb per cu ft. Normal-weight concrete runs about 140–155.

truckCap.description: Truck capacity. Unit: cu yd (imperial) or m³ (metric). Assumption, cubic yards per load. Ask your producer.

minLoad.description: Producer minimum load. Unit: cu yd (imperial) or m³ (metric). Optional. Cubic yards. Leave blank unless your producer quotes one.

shortFee.description: Short-load fee. Unit: $ flat. Optional. Flat charge your producer adds below that minimum.
